decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed roof extensions, because of their size, position,  appearance and design would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of numbers 82 and 84 Syon Lane and is complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the roof extensions are used.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the  east and west elevations shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of side and rear dormer roof extension to dwellinghouse.
